description: Bounded CPU-decision slice (ticket #12): 1P Ryu vs CPU Retsu, round 1, the same boot path as sf-fixed-fight-01 / sf-idle-scene-01 with no fight inputs (P1 idle). FIGHT! is erased at 2389; the fight loop starts at 2390, where the CPU opponent makes its first decision: from its AI tables and the random state it starts move 0x0a, a forward jump toward Ryu (jump sound 0xa6 on the latch at 2391), landing in its stance at 2433 (landing sound 0x19 at 2431); its second decision follows at 2434, outside the interval. The compared interval is 2389..=2433 with checkpoints every frame. See docs/reference/cpu-decision.md.

reference.notes: US set 1, six-button controls; MAME set sf. ROM set verified by mame -verifyroms against the pinned build.
